about.body:
Bedside English

Medical English speaking practice for IMGs.

Modes: Patient Encounter · Residency Interview · Custom Scenario
Voice AI: Gemini Live · OpenAI Realtime
Analysis: Claude API

Version {version}
about.title: About Bedside English

ai_report.privacy_note: The edited AI response, your selected reason, the optional note, and limited technical details (provider, model, app version, screen, and report ID) will be sent to the developer through Google Apps Script and stored in a private Google Sheet. Audio, API keys, and the rest of the transcript are not included.

onboarding.v2.why_key: Why does the app need my own key?
onboarding.v2.why_key_body: Live voice and feedback come directly from Gemini. Using your own key keeps your quota and provider settings under your control; the app sends the key only to Google's Gemini API and stores it encrypted on this device.
onboarding.v2.why_not_chatgpt_body: Good question—general-purpose voice chat may already be available through a service you use. Here's what Bedside English adds to that conversation:
onboarding.v2.why_not_chatgpt_point1: Remembers your mistakes across sessions and re-tests them with spaced repetition, instead of forgetting the moment the chat ends.
onboarding.v2.why_not_chatgpt_point2: Scores you against a reference case and checklist, with an honest confidence badge — not just a chatbot being encouraging.
onboarding.v2.why_not_chatgpt_point3: Already had that conversation? Import the transcript later (Home → Import a Conversation) and it gets scored here too.
onboarding.v2.why_not_chatgpt_title: Why not just use ChatGPT or Gemini's live voice mode?
openbook.brief.ask: What this diagnosis makes you ask
openbook.brief.body: Nobody walks into a room with no handover. Here's the case — so the only thing left to work out in there is how to say it in English.
openbook.brief.graduate: Last time in this specialty you only needed level %d. You may not need this brief — try going in cold.
openbook.brief.offer: Next time, brief me before I walk in →
openbook.brief.skip: Skip the brief, go in cold
openbook.brief.title: Before you go in
openbook.closing.body: Try each move in your own English first, then reveal the model sentence and compare.
openbook.closing.chart_label: CHART WORDING — DON'T SAY THIS ALOUD
openbook.closing.intro: The visit doesn't end when the questions run out. Four moves close it, and they're the same four in every case — only the disease changes.
openbook.closing.point.explain: Name the problem, then say what it means in words the patient actually uses.
openbook.closing.point.plan: One concrete next step, and what it will tell you. One is enough.
openbook.closing.point.safety_net: What would make this urgent, and exactly what to do about it. Leaving this out is the most commonly marked-down omission.
openbook.closing.point.teach_back: Hand the explaining back to the patient to check it landed. Never "do you understand?".
openbook.closing.reveal.frame: What do I say at the end?
openbook.closing.reveal.script: Show me how to say the closing in English
openbook.closing.title: Closing — "So what do I do now, doctor?"
openbook.disclaimer: Study aid for English speaking practice. Not clinical guidance.
openbook.hud.closing_next: All asked — now close the visit

preflight.headphones_body: Without headphones, your microphone can pick up the AI voice from your speakers and make it reply to itself. Headphones or earbuds prevent this.

preflight.mic_quiet: We barely heard you. Check your input device in Preferences, then try again.

prefs.azure_active_detail: Azure Speech listens blind first and diagnoses only failed turns. Gemini receives text evidence only and remains the automatic fallback.
prefs.azure_both_required: Both the Azure key and region are required.
prefs.azure_optional_detail: Optional: add Azure Speech credentials for specialist diagnosis. Without them, the current Gemini path continues unchanged.
prefs.azure_region_invalid: Enter the resource region name, not a URL.
prefs.azure_score_principle: Pass/fail is based on what blind speech recognition heard, not Azure's accent, fluency, prosody, or overall pronunciation score.
prefs.backup_detail: Move your practice history, feedback, review progress, settings, and optional saved voice clips to another device. API keys are never included.
prefs.backup_error_damaged: This backup file is damaged or incomplete, so it cannot be restored. Use another copy if you have one.
prefs.backup_error_generic: Check the file and password, then try again.
prefs.backup_error_newer_version: This backup was created by a newer version of the app. Update the app, then try again.
prefs.backup_error_no_space: There is not enough free space on this device to restore this backup. Free some space and try again.
prefs.backup_error_not_backup: That file is not a Bedside English backup. Choose a file ending in .bsebackup.
prefs.backup_error_password: That password does not match this backup file. Check it and try again.
prefs.backup_error_session_active: End the current practice session first, then back up or restore.
prefs.backup_error_too_large: There is too much practice history to fit in one backup file.
prefs.backup_error_too_much_audio: There are too many saved voice clips to back up. Turn off "Include saved learner voice clips" and try again.
prefs.backup_error_weak_password: The backup password must be at least 8 characters.
prefs.backup_export_notice: This backs up sessions, transcripts, analysis, scores, corrections, review progress, listening history, goals, usage history, trash, and general settings. API keys, logs, caches, and device-only paths are excluded.
prefs.backup_export_success: Backup saved: {sessions} sessions and {audio} voice clips.
prefs.backup_password_warning: I understand that this password is not stored or recoverable. If I forget it, this backup cannot be restored.
prefs.backup_keep_open: Keep the app open. A large backup can take several minutes.
prefs.backup_replace_warning: I understand that the current learning data, general settings, and saved voice clips on this device will be replaced by this backup. If the backup was made without voice clips, the clips on this device are deleted.
prefs.backup_restore_complete: Restored {sessions} sessions and {audio} voice clips. The app will restart to load all restored settings. API keys were not restored.
prefs.backup_restore_notice: Enter the password used when this backup was created. API keys on this device will remain unchanged.

prefs.key_format_gemini: That doesn't look like a valid key — it should be a long token, often starting with 'AIza'.

Prevents the AI from hearing its own voice through your speakers.
Turn OFF only if you want to barge in and interrupt the AI mid-sentence.
prefs.mute_while_speaking: Mute microphone while AI is speaking (recommended without headphones)
prefs.native_explanations_detail: Correction and coaching explanations are written in your native language; the English fixes stay in English. Default off.
prefs.native_language_hint: Used for L1-aware feedback and language-specific drills. It does not change the app UI language.
prefs.open_book_brief_detail: Shows the diagnosis and what to ask about it before the microphone opens, like a ward handover. Turns the session into pure English practice instead of a diagnosis test. Never affects your score.
prefs.open_book_detail: Reveal the patient's diagnosis and what to ask about it, one level at a time. For learners whose clinical knowledge, not their English, is what stalls a case. Never affects your score.
prefs.open_book_mic.always: Mute the whole time it's open
prefs.open_book_mic.always_detail: Exam-style: read, close the sheet, then speak.
prefs.open_book_mic.never_detail: The conversation keeps running while you read.
prefs.open_book_mic.reading_detail: Recommended. Muted for the candidate list and the diagnosis; live again for the checklist, the model questions and the closing script — the parts you read aloud to the patient.
prefs.open_book_mic_detail: The answer sheet has levels you read and levels you say out loud. Choose what the microphone does.
prefs.open_book_mic_title: Microphone while Open Book is open
prefs.pace_explanation: Applies to live voice sessions through the system prompt. Use Fast or Challenge to train real US hospital listening speed.
prefs.pronunciation_label: Analyze mic audio for L1 pronunciation errors after each session
prefs.pronunciation_value: First checks what Gemini hears without showing the expected words, then diagnoses likely sound, stress, rhythm, or intonation causes. Confirmed findings can enter spaced repetition. This is still Gemini audio judgment, not a clinical-grade phoneme scorer.
prefs.pronunciation_warning: On by default because pronunciation clarity is a core feature. Learner-turn audio is sent to Gemini twice in small batches: first for blind listening, then for diagnosis. You can turn it off here. Headphones are recommended and cost scales with speaking time.
prefs.restart_note: Some changes apply after a restart.
prefs.speaker_tip: Tip: with a Bluetooth headset, pick its 'Hands-Free' output if the normal one is silent during sessions.
prefs.strict_listener_detail: Speaking checks use a telephone-band signal and a tougher 'understood' bar, closer to a real phone order or noisy ward. Default off.

prefs.summary_privacy_none: Nothing extra is stored or shared

prefs.voice_clips_detail: Save only your spoken turns on this device as compact M4A files so they can be replayed from transcripts. AI audio is not saved. Say It practice recordings are kept the same way.
pron.blank_hint: The blank is yours to fill — the model voice pauses there. Say the whole sentence with your own words in the gap.
pron.blind_judge_principle: The AI wrote what it heard before seeing the target. It checks message delivery, not native-like accent.
pron.discern_prompt: Play the word, then tap the one you heard. Three in a row unlocks speaking — you can only fix a sound you can hear.
pron.discern_title: Ear check: which did you hear?
pron.judge_failed: The AI check didn't come back — your attempt was not graded. Try the check again.
pron.judge_failed_quota: Today's free AI check limit for this model is used up. It resets tomorrow — or switch the analysis model/provider in Preferences. This attempt will remain ungraded.
pron.judge_principle: Judged on whether a listener would understand you — not on sounding native.
pron.judge_unavailable: AI check needs a Gemini key (Preferences). You can still record and compare by ear.
pron.mic_permission: Microphone permission is needed to record your attempt.
pron.mic_silent: No sound is reaching the app. Speak up, move the phone closer, or check that nothing else is using the mic.
pron.no_clip: No saved recording for this turn — audio capture may have been off.
pron.quality_clipped: That recording was too loud and distorted. Move the phone a little farther away.
pron.quality_no_speech: Almost no speech was found in that recording. Start speaking after you tap Record.
pron.quality_noisy: Background noise drowned out your voice. Try a quieter spot, or hold the phone closer to your mouth.
pron.quality_too_quiet: That recording was very quiet. Hold the phone about a hand's width away and speak at normal volume.
pron.quality_too_short: That recording was too short to check. Tap Record, say the whole sentence, then tap Stop.
pron.recording_hint: Recording… tap Stop when you finish the sentence.
pron_lab.empty_body: Finish a session like a patient encounter and your pronunciation corrections collect here. Make sure Settings → Pronunciation analysis is on.
pron_lab.observed_hint: {count} sound(s) noticed once, waiting to be confirmed. If the same slip returns in another session it joins your practice list.
redo.subtitle: Reading a correction is not learning it. Say each corrected sentence out loud before you leave — passes and misses update your review schedule.
redo.title: Say it right now

survival.rapid_fire_desc: ⚡ The AI asks brisk, specific questions about today, the shared setting, and immediate everyday choices.

survival.tagline: Real life doesn't follow a script. A random everyday situation — the AI talks first, you react.

tour.coach_body: Tap here anytime to practice speaking out loud with an AI coach — no full session needed. Perfect for a quick warm-up.
tour.help_body: Stuck? The “?” opens the full guide. The gear lets you change your language, API keys and preferences whenever you like.
tour.history_body: Revisit past sessions, replay transcripts and feedback, and watch your scores improve over time.
tour.home_body: Your daily starting point — a suggested mission, your streak and progress, and a one-tap way into practice.
tour.loop_1: 1.  Pick a case, or press ‘Start Now’ on the Dashboard.
tour.loop_2: 2.  Speak with the AI in English—no typing and no push-to-talk.
tour.loop_3: 3.  Press ‘End & Analyze’ to get feedback and corrections.
tour.loop_4: 4.  Your mistakes are saved and resurface later for review.
tour.modes_hint: More modes unlock after your first session — start with Patient Encounter.
tour.modes_sub: More modes unlock after your first session—start with Patient Encounter.
tour.practice_body: Every practice mode lives here: patient encounters, OSCE/OET stations, residency interviews, teach-back and survival English. Pick a case and start speaking.
tour.pron_body: Drill tricky clinical words and sounds. Hear a model, say it back, and get instant feedback on how clearly it came across.
tour.srs_body: Every mistake you make is saved here and resurfaces at just the right time, so your corrections actually stick.
tour.title: How Bedside English works
tour.welcome_body: Here's a 30-second tour of what each part of the app does. You can skip anytime.
unlock.body: The demo uses a scripted patient with no AI. Your own free Google Gemini key unlocks live AI voice, clinical scoring, targeted corrections, a SOAP note, and senior-attending rephrasings — all on your real voice. It takes about a minute and costs a fraction of a cent per session.
unlock.body_everyday: The typed demo uses no live AI audio. Your own free Google Gemini key unlocks live conversation, everyday speaking feedback, pronunciation coaching, and natural listen-and-repeat alternatives on your real voice.
unlock.bridge_body: Start with a relaxed, unscored live warm-up — same gentle pace as before, just with the AI actually hearing you this time.
unlock.bridge_subtitle: Live AI voice, clinical scoring, and corrections are ready on your own words.
unlock.get_key: Get a free key (opens Google AI Studio)
unlock.invalid: That doesn't look like a valid key — it should be a long token, often starting with 'AIza'.
unlock.success: Key activated! Start a new session to use live AI voice and full feedback.
unlock.title: Unlock the full app

phrasebook.intro: Stuck for the sentence? Open it one step at a time — what the move is, then the frame, then the words. Nothing here costs you anything.
phrasebook.level1.body: Each of these is something you could do right now. Try it in your own English first.
phrasebook.level2.body: The frame is fixed; the blank is yours. Fill it and say the whole thing out loud.

Spoken English for nurses heading abroad: Spoken English for nurses heading abroad. OET role-plays are scored on the nine OET Speaking criteria with a practice grade estimate. Ward scenarios (US, UK, Australia) cover handover and escalation, patient teaching, bedside care and speaking up, each scored on a nursing rubric with your brief's tasks ticked off one by one. Job interviews practise the recruiter, manager and panel conversations that come before the job. Pick your goal at the top to see the scenarios for it.
